name: scientific-figure-builder-reviewer
description: Build editable scientific figures from human-approved whole-image drafts or references and perform fail-closed final reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Whole-first scientific figure building and audit
interface.longDescription: A two-skill toolkit for human-approved whole-image drafts, automatic asset segmentation, staged reconstruction as editable PowerPoint objects, controlled raster enhancement, and an explicit read-only final audit.
defaultPrompt: Use $scientific-figure-builder to create or rebuild this figure in PowerPoint.
Use $scientific-figure-reviewer to audit this PPT against its reference.
